title: [TEST] Add isTerminalStatus() to the improvement queue
problem: Panels decide which proposals are finished with their own hardcoded status lists, which drifted when new states were added.
observation: GenesisNotificationsPanel keeps a local DONE_STATUSES list.
proposedSolution: Export isTerminalStatus(status) from src/core/selfdev/ImprovementQueue.ts (true for Integrated, Recorded, Rejected, Rolled Back) and cover it with a node:test unit test in tests/. Do not change any other behaviour.
expectedBenefit: One definition of a finished proposal.
testPlan: Unit test for isTerminalStatus over every status.

lastExecution.plan: Add an exported TERMINAL_STATUSES list and an isTerminalStatus(status) predicate to ImprovementQueue.ts, next to the existing PENDING_APPROVAL_STATUSES and RUNNING_STATUSES. It returns true only for Integrated, Recorded, Rejected and Rolled Back. No existing caller is changed (the panel, open() and hasOpenSimilar() keep their current behaviour), as the proposal requires. A new node:test file checks every status against a Record<ImprovementStatus, boolean> table, so a newly added status also fails typecheck until its terminal-ness is decided.
